Was Don even invited?


Marco Foster (@MarcoFoster_)

Don Lemon on the White House Correspondents’ Dinner: “This is not normal. The Trump regime is trying to take away press freedom. They are trying to kill the First Amendment. You have to take a stand and if you’re in that room you are co-signing this. You are complicit in normalizing something that should not be normal”

"He is a vile and disgusting man."

Hakeem Jeffries (@RepJeffries)

Thankful for the swift law enforcement action to protect everyone from gunfire at the White House Correspondents Dinner.

Praying for the safety of those who may remain in harm’s way.

The violence and chaos in America must end.



— https://nitter.net/RepJeffries/status/2048210669518958863#m

Candace will mock this on her podcast. Absolute guarantee.


KanekoaTheGreat (@KanekoaTheGreat)

Erika Kirk breaks down in tears as she leaves the White House dinner after shots were fired.

She was tragically widowed when a left-wing assassin took her husband’s life.

Heartbreaking to see what Charlie Kirk’s wife has gone through.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/KanekoaTheGreat/status/2048227262869496189#m

Steve Guest (@SteveGuest)

8:08 pm: CNN's S.E. Cupp blasted President Donald Trump saying that he was “A guy who wants us dead…"

8:34 pm: Someone tried to shoot up the White House Correspondents Dinner where President Trump was set to speak.

S.E. Cupp's take aged horrifically.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/SteveGuest/status/2048217495815766161#m

And… it’s cancelled. There’s no conceivable way to continue this tonight.


Joe Concha (@JoeConchaTV)

If the Correspondents Dinner continues after this, it will be the most asinine decision one could possibly imagine.

“They said journalists should make him uncomfortable during the evening.”
